context.why: The page where a person edits their own profile, reached from the edit action and checklist on their overview page. This story also builds what the next two stories reuse: Contributor.is_editable_by, LinesField, the Update page and the FAIRDM_PROFILE_FORMS setting. Owners, administrators and community managers come in US2 and US3: in this story Person.is_editable_by is true only for the person themself, and Organization keeps the base class's False.
prior_decisions: decisions.md D2, D3, D4, D7, D8, D9, D10. Read those entries.

An additional view is governed by its OWN `check`, not its owner's (fairdm/core/project/plugins.py lines 43-53 explain it). Update declares its own check as a named module function. A visitor is redirected to sign in; a signed-in user without the right gets 403.

FAIRDM_PROFILE_FORMS: get_form_class() uses the portal's entry for the record's kind and falls back to the shipped form when the setting or the key is absent. In this story the organization kind has no shipped form yet: an organization's page is refused by is_editable_by anyway, so do not build a placeholder form.
The page edits `name` only. Given and family name are an open question on the specification (D9): do not add them, and the FR-019 test covers `name` only.
The image field follows ProjectForm: validate_image_file_size, a clearable input. The widget ids are Django's defaults (id_image, id_profile, id_links): checklist Fix links use them as fragments.
The person overview keeps the Contact stand-in for anyone looking at someone else's profile. Only the edit stand-in and the About card's prompt become links.

Delete the unused UserProfileForm and fix Contributor.get_update_url() to reverse contributor:overview-update. The stale `contributor-update` references in templates/cotton/contributor/card/contribution.html point at a contribution's edit page, a different thing: leave them.

acceptance.given_when_then: Given the form tests listed in tasks.md T001, when run before the code exists, then they fail for the missing module; after T005 they pass.
Given each kind of user in tasks.md T002, when is_editable_by is asked about a person, then only the person themself may edit.

Given US-1 scenarios 2 to 6 and 8 to 11, when the real page is opened and submitted through the test client, then each Then holds, refused requests store nothing, and the setting falls back to the shipped form.

Given a person on their own overview and on someone else's, when the page renders, then the edit action, the About prompt and the three checklist items link to the editing page or its field, and a stranger is offered no edit link.
Given the failing tests from T001 to T004, when the implementation lands, then all pass with no migration.
Given the documentation pages named in tasks.md T006, when the docs step runs, then it passes and the example of a portal adding a field runs as written.
